name: Rybbit
description: Rybbit is a privacy-friendly, cookieless web and product analytics platform and an open source alternative to Google Analytics. It tracks pageviews, sessions, goals, funnels, user journeys and errors, and can record session replays.

notes.text: Open https://<IP>/signup and accept the self-signed certificate; the first account becomes the admin. Then set DISABLE_SIGNUP=true in /opt/rybbit_data/.env and restart rybbit-server.

Visitors' browsers only load the tracking script from a trusted HTTPS address. Put Rybbit behind a reverse proxy with a real certificate and pass that URL as var_base_url at install; it is compiled into the web client.
ClickHouse needs a CPU with AVX2 on x86.

app_vars.name: var_base_url
app_vars.label: Public URL
app_vars.help: e.g. https://analytics.example.com; defaults to https://<container IP>
